pages: Marn Kell, a woman of forty-one with dark hair in a knot, wears a waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket and stands at the head of the coal steps with one hand flat on the timber-framed tide board. Middle distance: a coil of mooring rope, a brass lamp post. Background: wet steps falling to slate-green harbour water, flat overcast light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, draws one white chalk line down the slate face of the tide board with a chalk stub between her fingers. Middle distance: a folded chart, a tin of chalk stubs, a damp cloth. Background: black coal steps and grey harbour water behind her, low overcast light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, runs one small brass cursor along the printed scale of a brass slide rule held flat in her palm. Middle distance: an open tide table, a pencil, a tin cup. Background: the slate tide board and grey morning sky above the harbour, cold coastal light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, marks the start of a window in chalk on the slate tide board, the chalk held flat to the stone. Middle distance: a folded tide table, a ledger, an ink tin. Background: wet coal steps and slate-green water, flat grey daylight.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, lays one rolled Admiralty chart across the tide board's timber shelf and weights a corner with a brass slide. Middle distance: a printed tide table, a pair of dividers, a pencil stub. Background: the harbour mouth under flat grey sky, zinc-white light on the water.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, stands with one hand on the tide board's frame, looking out past the coal steps. Middle distance: a grey steel coaster lying in the roads, a mooring buoy. Background: slate-green sea and a low grey horizon, high overcast light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, lays one fingertip on a chalked line of figures on the slate board, her back to the steps. Middle distance: a brass slide rule, a folded tide table, a chalk stub. Background: the harbour mouth and flat grey water, dull morning light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, writes one more line of figures in chalk along the bottom edge of the slate tide board. Middle distance: a wet notebook with a pencilled figure, the brass slide, a tin cup. Background: black coal steps and wind-flattened harbour water, grey afternoon light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, writes her initials in chalk beneath the window on the slate board, the chalk gripped hard in her fist. Middle distance: a stencilled tin, a damp cloth, the brass slide rule. Background: coal steps and slate-green water below, low overcast light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, lifts one corner of a grey tarpaulin in the shed behind the gauge house. Middle distance: a weathered slate board under sacking, a coil of tarred rope, a galvanised bucket. Background: the open shed doorway and grey daylight over a shingle yard.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, stands at the stilling well and lifts one brass drum cover, watching the pen draw its single line. Middle distance: a float in the well, a wire over a pulley, a dated tin. Background: the gauge house window and black water, first light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, lays one sheet of gauge paper flat on the bench and smooths it with both palms. Middle distance: the brass drum, a dated tin, a stone mole out of the window. Background: grey dawn over the harbour mouth, flat cold light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, taps one knuckle against a chalked window on the slate tide board in its timber frame. Middle distance: a folded tide table, a pencil, a tin of chalk stubs. Background: black coal steps falling away to the harbour, overcast afternoon light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, leans at the gauge house window with one pencil held over an open log book. Middle distance: a brass drum on its stand, a barometer in a wooden case, a hanging lamp. Background: night water and a coaster's lights far out.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, closes one hand round the brass slide rule and writes a figure in her open ledger with a pencil. Middle distance: an envelope of stevedore's paper, a tin cup, a slate offcut. Background: the harbour and the mill roof, overcast morning light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, spreads one loading computer printout on the board's shelf and holds it flat with her palm. Middle distance: a brass slide rule, a pencil, a pair of dividers. Background: the coal steps and flat grey harbour water, dull daylight.

A woman of fifty in a mill coat and cotton kerchief lays one bare thumb on a new slate board set in its timber frame, four ruled lines beneath her hand. Middle distance: a stub of chalk, a folded tide table, a tin cup. Background: black coal steps and grey harbour water, flat overcast light.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, lifts one folded invoice off a nail and slides it into her ledger. Middle distance: a brass slide rule, a date book, a tin cup on the shelf. Background: the harbour and a grey coaster alongside the mill, low bright sun.

Marn Kell, dark hair in a knot, waxed mustard-yellow oilcloth jacket, rests one fingertip on the open ledger beside a loading computer printout, a pencil laid across it. Middle distance: a brass slide rule, a paper clip, an ink tin. Background: the slate tide board and grey harbour water, evening light.
